newsitem.title: EU: Reuters Long-Term EU Diary for Aug 30 - Dec 31, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Reuters Long-Term EU Diary for Aug 30 - Dec 31, 1997.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
LUXEMBOURG - Luxembourg hosts summit of European Union leaders (December 12-13).
END OF SEPTEMBER
NEW YORK - NATO and Russia hold council at ministerial level.
SATURDAY, AUGUST 30

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Belgian Royal Technical Society of Heating, Ventilation and Related Technology Industry (ATIC) and Federation of European Heating and Airconditioning Associations (REHVA) hold World Conference CLIMA 2000 (To September 2). Venue: Palais des Congres. Contact: ATIC, c/o SRBII, Ravenstein 3, 1000 Brussels (322) 511 7469.
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 2

LEUVEN, Belgium - EU Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert attends European Association for Research in Industrial Economics conference (1830/1630 GMT); speaks on recent decisions in EU competition policy. Venue: Hogenheuvel College, Naamsestraat 69, Leuven.
SUNDAY, SEPTEMBER 7
ECHTERNACH, Luxembourg - EU agriculture ministers hold informal meeting (To September 9). No agenda yet available.
MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 8
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - EU Multidisciplinary Scientific Committee meets to discuss questions related to restrictions on material that could transmit madcow disease to humans.
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 10

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds conference on "Regional policy and business investments in an enlarged EU" (0845/0645 GMT). Speakers include: Chairman of the European Parliament Budgets Committee Detlev Samland. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 12
MONDORF, Luxembourg - EU finance ministers hold informal meeting (To September 14). No agenda yet available.
BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime seminar on " Reporting the European Union" (1315/1115 GMT). Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 15
BRUSSELS - EU foreign ministers meet (To September 16). No agenda yet available.

STRASBOURG - European Parliament holds plenary session (To September 19). Agenda items include relations with African, Caribbean and Pacific countries, comparative advertising, RAPHAEL cultural programme, postal services, equality between men and women, sexual exploitation of women, draft 1998 EU budget, protection of personal data, EU-Turkey customs union, mechanism for monitoring carbon dioxide emissions, universal service in a competitive telecommunications environment.

BILBAO, Spain - Luxembourg EU Presidency and the European Agency for Safety and Health at Work hold joint conference on "Good Safety and Health - Good Business for Europe". Speakers include: President of the EU Council of Ministers and Prime Minister of Luxembourg Jean-Claude Juncker; Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar Lopez; European Parliament President Jose Maria Gil-Robles; European Employment and Social Affairs Commissioner Padraig Flynn. Contact: Alun Jones, European Agency for Safety and Health at Work (344) 479 4377.

BRUSSELS - Privacy International holds conference on "Cryptography and the Internet - Developing privacy and security policy for the European Information Society". Speakers include EU Internal Market Commissioner Mario Monti. Venue: to be confirmed. Contact: Privacy International - Washington Office (1 202) 544 9240.
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 17
BRUSSELS - EU Committee of the Regions holds plenary session (To September 18).
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 18

STOCKHOLM - European Foundation for Quality Management (EFQM) hosts European business excellence forum (To Sept 19). Participants include former High Representative to Bosnia Carl Bildt. Contact: EFQM (322) 775 3511.
FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 19
BANGKOK - European and Asian finance ministers meet under the Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM) framework.
BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime seminar on "EU enlargement: assessing the candidates" (1315/1115 GMT). Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 22
BRUSSELS - EU agriculture ministers meet (To September 23). No agenda yet available.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime seminar on "Israel's association agreement with the European Union" (1315/1115 GMT). Speaker is Israel Ambassador to the EU Efraim Halevy. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 23
BRUSSELS - European Federation of Health Products Manufacturers' Association holds conference on "The Regulation of Food Supplements in the EU". Contact: Terry Woodger (44) 1276 451 647.
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 24

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds conference on "Turkey: political and economic challenges and opportunities ahead" (0945/0745 GMT). Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.

BRUSSELS - Forum Europe, International Duty Free Confederation (IDFC), the Association Francaise du Commerce Hors Taxes (AFCOHT) and the European Commission hold joint conference on "Duty Free in Europe" (0900/0700GMT). Venue: Concert Noble, rue d'Arlon 82, Brussels. Contact: Roberta Bonometti at Forum Europe (322) 736 1430.
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 25

BRUSSELS - Airtouch and Unisource hold conference on EU telecoms liberalisation. Participants include Airtouch Europe International Operations Europe Vice President Vern Tyerman and Unisource Chairman of the Board Paul Smits. Venue: Amigo Hotel. Contact: Adriana Nugter, European Public Policy (322) 627 0790.

BRUSSELS - International Centre of Research and Information on the Public and Cooperative Economy (CIRIEC) holds conference on "The public, social and cooperative economy and the general interest - Which roles in the 21st century?" (0830/0630 GMT) (To September 26). Speakers include European Commissioner Monika Wulf-Mathies. Venue: Palais des Congres. Contact: CIRIEC (322) 366 2746.
SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 27
TOKYO - Asian and European economy ministers meet under the Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM) framework. (To September 29).
MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 29

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime seminar on "The energy charter treaty: a fresh start for east-west energy business" (1315/1115 GMT). Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
BRUSSELS - Euromanagement hosts third annual conference on "National telecoms debate" (0830/0630 GMT) (To September 30). Venue: Holiday Inn. Contact: Christiane Vander Motte (322) 469 3650.
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 1
BRUSSELS - European Parliament holds mini session (To October 2).
BRUSSELS - EU Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds plenary session (To October 2).

BRUSSELS - Global Standards Conference holds conference on "Building the global information society for the 21st century - New applications and business opportunities - Coherent standards and regulations" (To October 3). Venue: Palace Hotel. Contact: European Commission Directorate-General III (Industry) (322) 511 7455.
MAASTRICHT - NATO defence ministers hold informal meeting (To Oct 2).
